properties.name: ПІСЛЯСВІТ 3D — Обсерваторія v0.9.42 · Softer Lens / Bridge Glow / Tamed Orbs
properties.description: Isolated Observatory visual readability pass: solid blue depth sky and three neon-lit projector face billboards, higher-contrast transparent cones. Original source 0.9.6 movement/optics and checkpoint logic unchanged. | v0.9.4: neon 3D asset integration after visual references: curved-leg spider, pink and cyan coral, anemones, two spotlight variants, console and platform modules. Original puzzle/physics/camera unchanged. | v0.9.5 dark underwater depth; procedural 3D ruins, observatory domes and fish; corrected clipped lights, spider facing and distracting underfloor teeth; unchanged gameplay. | Full scene single-screen fixed 3D camera; full-level puzzle composition and playable geometry maintained. | v0.9.7: cinematic camera intro zoom on Spalakh, reveal entire puzzle at switch A, close escape shot near exit; lower viewing angle 82 degrees. No puzzle geometry or asset changes. | v0.9.8: intro zoom returns when Spalakh backtracks; slower camera zoom transitions; lower almost side-on view; late-night underwater lighting. | v0.9.9: 8 new real GLB art assets (7 families): smooth rounded pink coral and cyan anemone, dark spider with pink-cyan legs and glowing eyes, dark matte hanging/standing projector with emissive lens only, industrial switch with tiny indicator only, soft gradient stone platform block. Gameplay camera, collision geometry and puzzle code unchanged. | v0.9.10 material, lighting and FX only: 7 refreshed GLB material skins; glowing corals and anemones via original emissive; readable spider gradients via Basic unlit shader; matte lamp and console housing with emissive lens/indicator; brighter moonlit stone; underwater atmospheric background image, depth mist, local nonshadow cyan/magenta/blue lights; transparent bridge glow. Identical camera and gameplay logic. | v0.9.11: GLB volumetric Spalakh character with 4 embedded keyframe animations Idle, Run, Jump, Fall; articulated rig with animated arms, legs, head, hair, embers. GDevelop Player object replaces old hidden GLB and sprite frame swapping; original 2D sprites retained but hidden. No gameplay, physics, camera or puzzle change. | v0.9.12: repaired six NaN flame mesh position/normal buffers in animated GLB; keep-aspect volumetric character with bottom-centered pivot and world-ground positioning; controls, physics, optics, camera unchanged. | v0.9.13: place genuine animated 3D Player at camera-facing Y=185, clear of stage platform front-face Y=115, avoiding severe depth occlusion. Preserve Z-ground/puzzle movement, all four GLB animations, 3D camera and original optics. | v0.9.14: brand-new GLB filename and Player instance to bypass stale bounds; explicitly sized model 132x108x225 with keepAspectRatio disabled; force pivot at feet, camera-facing orientation, move in front of stage and align glow; no changes to camera or puzzle physics. | v0.9.15: native GDevelop 3D hybrid with latest v084e 2D Spalakh sprite animations (Idle 6, Run 7, Jump 3, Fall 3, Land 4); original scripted controls, bridge and camera unchanged. Old GLB Player removed from scene. | v0.9.16: fix upside-down duplicate sprites when moving left by replacing 180-degree panel rotation with native GDevelop 3D flipX; model physics, camera, puzzle optics unchanged. | v0.9.17: replaced corrupted 0.9.10 Moon asset references with validated intact v0.9.9 GLBs, preserving silhouettes and original optics; spider restores vertex color with KeepOriginal rather than GDevelop Basic; sprite panels render only their camera-facing face to prevent duplicated upside-down reverse image. | v0.9.18: correct 2D frame UV orientation with faceOrientation=Z and inverse X mirror, align foot baseline, attach tilted cone planes to real 3D spotlight origins and targets; animate two red neon eyes and a point light for each spider. Camera, controls, puzzle physics unchanged. | v0.9.19: align the 2.5D Spalakh camera-facing XZ sprite depth with physical GDevelop 3D platform volumes (Y=-8 vs invalid front Y=158), anchor sprite bottom to worldZ(s.y)+2 for floors, raised ledges, light bridge, and jumping. Physics, camera, optical puzzles, animations and neon spider eye work unchanged. | v0.9.20: individual visual foot baselines for Idle/Run/Jump/Fall/Land, latched surface class during air time and depth corrections for thick main stage; six spherical emissive GLB eyes attached to the spider heads replace red squares and old halos; original GDevelop camera and puzzle logic unchanged. | v0.9.21: fix lower thick-platform and light-bridge screen-space visual foot alignment with inward depth placement and small lift; visually snap feet to collidable ledge edges while keeping physics untouched; use correctly horizontal top-face glow decal at collider height; keep upper-ledge anchors, spider eye GLB, optics and camera unchanged. | v0.9.22: tune Main/Bridge/Mid/Upper visual depth, stand/land lift and edge inset with SURFACE_PRESET; choose actual 3D support surface among all 8 solids and 3 light bridge tiles; stabilize feet when airborne; keep physics/puzzles/camera and neon spider eyes unchanged. | v0.9.24: full Idle16/16, Slow8/8 and Crouch5/5 sprites while preserving Run/Jump/Fall/Land; per-cycle animation clock; measured foot scan resource fix for indices >=10; illuminated surface decals and real dynamic 3D pointlights where projector shafts meet platforms; optics panel visual depth moved behind hero without changing puzzle interaction. | v0.9.25: graphics pass 1 — blue-teal background colour instead of black, light scene fog, 48 drifting water motes, 5 faint upper-ruin light shafts, soft glow behind corals/anemones; all via existing textures, guarded GFX_QUALITY switch; gameplay/physics/camera/puzzles untouched. | Added crisp PNG parallax layers: transparent ruins backdrop + transparent shipwreck backdrop behind gameplay. Uses local assets in spalakh3d/assets. | v0.9.26 added uploaded GLB corals/anemones with pink, cyan and violet neon glows. | v0.9.27: GitHub-hosted 3D parallax PNG ship/ruins plus water backdrop, validated model3D resource type, 3-color native PointLight3D coral lights. No gameplay events changed. | v0.9.29: Jump/Fall frames do not loop, dynamic pink/gold speed-adaptive flame trail, switch-camera ease 40% longer. v0.9.34: контрольоване магічне полум'я без пересвічення, темніші руїни з рідкісним фіолетовим glow, неонові корали (cyan/pink/violet/yellow/white) з реальними PointLight та відблиском на платформах. | v0.9.35: compact attached flame, deep violet GLB silhouettes, stronger local coral reflections; game mechanics untouched. v0.9.36: промені стартують у лінзах (виміряний центр лінзи), м'яка пляма-контакт, прибрано квадратне обрізання шлейфу (порядок малювання спрайта), темні куполи з приглушеними вікнами. | v0.9.37: replace the three spiders using user's uploaded spider geometry re-rigged with eight independent leg groups; all black non-emissive materials; remove all red-eye meshes and red light instances; unique per-spider, per-leg asynchronous motion; gameplay/camera/puzzles untouched. | Three actual nonshadow SpotLights now originate at projector lenses and illuminate 3D stone, radial shader contact circles are surface-attached; shafts still represent light scattering in water. | v0.9.39: all gradient projector shaft meshes and native cone planes hidden; three real SpotLights, GDevelop PointLights, circular impact pools remain. Rectangular SpalakhAura plane hidden and replaced by feathered radial Three.js Sprite. Three black spiders' unsynchronised leg motion slowed ~50%; puzzles and physics untouched. | v0.9.40: Macro Foreground / DOF / Lens FX — власний пост-прохід у композері 3D-шару (мала глибина різкості навколо Спалаха, легка бочкоподібна дисторсія, хроматична аберація, віньєтка) та розмиті світні корали переднього плану без колізій; HUD, фізика, камера, пазли, павуки не змінені. | v0.9.41: прибрано прозорі прямокутні маски навколо героя і світлових зон; відновлено видимі вузькі об’ємні промені з удвічі сильнішим фізичним світлом; прибрано procedural foreground corals; підсилено shallow-DOF/tilt-shift ~3.4×. Gameplay/puzzles/camera/HUD unchanged. | v0.9.42: blur reduced ~2x; bridge beam/contact pool widened to almost full bridge span, bridge tinted bright cyan with glow; large orange coral halos reduced ~3x.

tests.description: Pressing Space makes the 3D character jump off the ground, and gravity brings it back down.
tests.name: Jumping with Space
source: // Space must make the physics character jump off the ground
harness.assert(characterState().IsOnFloor === true, 'The player stands on the ground.');
// Doing nothing must leave the player on the ground.
'The player stays on the ground while no key is pressed.'
harness.assert(sawJumping, 'The character reports it is jumping after pressing Space.');
harness.assert(leftTheFloor, 'The player leaves the floor when jumping.');
'The player rises well above the ground when jumping (rose by ' +
harness.assert(landedBack, 'The player falls back onto the ground.');
'The player lands back at the height it jumped from.'

tests.description: The player walks forward into a coin lying on the ground: the coin is picked up.
tests.name: Collecting a coin by walking into it
source: // Walking into a coin must collect it: the events delete a Coin as soon as
// it is within 50 units of the Player.
// "w" walks the character toward the direction it faces.
const forward = { x: Math.cos(forwardRadians), y: Math.sin(forwardRadians) };
// Arrange: stand the player back from a coin lying on the ground, so that
// the coin is straight ahead. Reaching it is still up to the game.
harness.assert(groundCoins.length > 0, 'There are coins lying on the ground.');
// Standing away from the coin must not collect anything: this is what makes
// the check below a test of the player walking into it.
'The coin to walk into is still there once the player is in place.'
'Walking forward into the coin collects it (the player ended up ' +
'The number of coins left in the level went down.'
// A picture of what the game looks like once this has happened, kept with
